gaps.sentence: He completed the marathon despite being ___ breath.
gaps.explanation: 'out of breath' = breathing fast from effort.

gaps.sentence: The smell was ___ this world — absolutely incredible.
The castle dates ___ to the fourteenth century.

gaps.explanation: 'from 1 January' = beginning on that date (also 'with effect from').

gaps.sentence: He denied everything ___ the face of the evidence.
gaps.hint: ___ the face of = when confronted with
gaps.explanation: 'in the face of' = despite / when confronted by.

gaps.sentence: The letter arrived ___ due course — three weeks later.
gaps.hint: ___ due course = at the expected time
gaps.explanation: 'in due course' = at the proper time eventually.

gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: ___ first, the plan sounded ridiculous — then it grew on us.
gaps.explanation: 'At first' = in the beginning (contrast with 'first' = before anything else).
